item.title: Drivers cautioned of logging in Ocala National Forest, potential road impact

item.title: Ocala man sues hookah lounge after being injured in fight
item.description: An Ocala man has filed a lawsuit against a local hookah lounge and its landlord, claiming that a lack of adequate security led to him being beaten up during a fight that spilled into the parking lot. Read more: Ocala man sues hookah lounge after being injured in fight

item.title: Ocala man arrested for AI-generated child porn
item.description: An Ocala man, who was out on bond following his July 2025 arrest on multiple child pornography possession charges, is back behind bars after AI-generated material depicting the sexual abuse of children was allegedly found in his possession. item.title: I think developers contributions to elected officials outweigh those from property owners
